macros.name: exercisenewpage
macros.doc: \exercisenewpage inserts only a page break if printsolution=false, so if the solutions are not printed.

macros.name: ifsolutionthenelse
macros.doc: With the command \ifsolutionthenelse{}{} you can print text depending on wether the solution is printed or not.

macros.name: totalpoints
macros.doc: The command \totalpoints can be used to print the sum of the points.
